purpose: Define adapter-type UserModules as symbol/protocol/schema translation and mount surfaces that expose or map existing semantics without becoming the owner of mounted symbols.

value.mount_rule: Adapter may expose/mount exact existing symbols into an adapter namespace/surface.
value.ownership_rule: Mounted symbol retains its original semantic owner.
value.translation_rule: Protocol/schema/value translation is explicit and typed.
value.identity_rule: Adapter-local alias is a binding and never replaces target semantic identity.
value.mutation_rule: Mutation, if supported, routes to the original owning operation/resource under normal authorization.
value.lifecycle_rule: Removing adapter removes the mount/binding, not the underlying source semantic object.
value.authority_rule: Adapter installation/reachability does not grant source authority.
